_capture.provenance: SYNTHETIC — no recording of this endpoint exists in the baseline and this programme has no account that could make one. manifest-authenticated.md § Session records that re-authenticating 'carries a randomised arithmetic captcha and an SMS OTP, and re-running it burns a real SMS', and a transcript capture would additionally need a message WRITTEN to a live account, which the slot 16-47 session explicitly refused ('This capture performed ZERO writes to the account'). B2-AC-36's 'real recorded staging payloads' standard is reported NOT EVALUATED with that reason and never PASS (specs.md § 2.2 Finding I, § 6.11, B9-AC-57).
_capture.credential: none — no host was contacted to build this file
_capture.envelope: PAGED. endpoints.ts:157 is api.paged<ChatMessage>, called with per_page: 100 (CustomerServiceChat.tsx:82).
_capture.chosen_to_discriminate: All FOUR sender_type values appear (citizen, agent, bot, system) — a transcript with only citizen and bot cannot fail the four-sender rendering test, and only `citizen` flips the row direction and the bubble colours (:365). `suggestions` is null on one bot message, [] on another and a two-item list on the LAST — the chips read messages[messages.length-1]?.suggestions (:192), so which one is last is the whole behaviour. Message 2 carries a **bold** run and a \n, exercising both of formatText's two rules (:171-180). read_at and attachment_url are present on some rows and MUST render nothing (B9-AC-44).
_capture.timestamps_are_zone_naive: sent_at carries NO `Z` and no offset, deliberately. clockTime renders in the HOST timezone on both sides (new Date(...).toLocaleTimeString / DateTime.toLocal), so a `Z` payload would make the Tier 1 oracle a function of the machine running the test. ECMAScript and Dart agree that a date-TIME form without a zone marker is local, so these render as the same wall clock everywhere. See clock_time.dart for the two divergences this does not paper over.
